name: combobox
purpose: A text field with a list of suggestions under it: typing filters the options, picking one fills the field, and a value that is not in the list is accepted as typed. It holds one string value, after the design sample's `ComboboxInput` and the ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern. It differs from `Select`, whose value must be one of its options and whose trigger is a button, and from `Command`, which runs commands from a palette instead of filling a form field.
useWhen: A form field whose usual values are known but a new one is valid: an environment variable name, a header, a path, a region tag, a branch.
A long option list the user would rather type than scroll, with the list as a reminder.
Options that come from the server as the user types (`search` event, `loading`, `filter: false`).
Suggestions grouped by origin (Recent, Suggested, System) in one field.
avoidWhen: The value must be one of a short fixed list → use `select` (or `radio-group` for 2–5 visible choices).
Searching and running commands or jumping to a page → use `command`.
Filtering a collection by properties → use `property-filter`.
Key/value pairs or tags → use `attribute-editor` or `tag-editor` (their key cells may hold a Combobox).
related: select` — closed list, button trigger, no free entry.
input` — the field Combobox is built on; use it alone when there are no suggestions.
field` — label, description and error around the Combobox; it reads id, invalid, disabled and required from it.
command` — palette of actions, not a form value.
property-filter` — token-based filtering with the same listbox look.
bestPractices: Put the Combobox in a `Field` so it gets a visible label; use `ariaLabel` only where no label can be shown.
Keep `allowCustom` on only when a new value is genuinely valid; with it off, the field restores the last valid value when the typed text matches nothing.
Give options a `description` for what tells them apart (a scope, a count), not a second copy of the label.
For server data set `filter` to `false`, listen to `search` (debounce on your side), and drive `loading` from the request.
Validate the committed value (`update:modelValue`) in the form, not each keystroke; `search` is for suggestions only.
Use `group` when options come from distinct sources; keep group titles one or two words.

props.name: options
props.doc: Suggestions: `{ value, label?, description?, group?, disabled? }`.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name when no `Field` label names the field.

props.name: allowCustom
props.doc: Accepts a typed value that matches no option, offered as `Use "…"`.

props.name: filter
props.doc: Filters `options` by the typed text. Turn off when the server filters on `search`.

props.name: clearable
props.doc: Shows a clear button while the field has a value.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows a spinner and the loading row while options are fetched.

props.name: emptyText
props.doc: Text of the list when nothing matches. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Shows the value without the list or editing.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Marks the field invalid (`aria-invalid`, danger border).

events.name: search
events.notes: The typed text, on each keystroke while the list is open (server filters).

events.name: create
events.notes: A value that matches no option was committed (`allowCustom`).

slots.name: option
slots.scope: { option: ComboboxOption, active: boolean, selected: boolean }
slots.notes: Replaces the content of one option row.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Combobox from '@aziontech/webkit/combobox'
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const name = ref('API_URL')

  const options = [
    { value: 'API_URL', description: 'Suggested' },
    { value: 'API_TOKEN', description: 'Suggested' },
    { value: 'NODE_ENV', description: 'System' },
    { value: 'LOG_LEVEL' },
    { value: 'CACHE_TTL' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <Field class="max-w-(--container-xs)">
    <Field.Label>Variable name</Field.Label>
    <Combobox
      v-model="name"
      :options="options"
      placeholder="Search or type a name"
      clearable
    />
    <Field.Description>Pick a known variable or type a new one.</Field.Description>
  </Field>
</template>

examples.name: Grouped
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Combobox from '@aziontech/webkit/combobox'
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const header = ref('')

  const options = [
    { value: 'X-Request-Id', group: 'Recent' },
    { value: 'X-Tenant', group: 'Recent' },
    { value: 'Cache-Control', group: 'Standard' },
    { value: 'Content-Type', group: 'Standard' },
    { value: 'Authorization', group: 'Standard', disabled: true, description: 'Managed' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <Field class="max-w-(--container-xs)">
    <Field.Label>Request header</Field.Label>
    <Combobox
      v-model="header"
      :options="options"
      placeholder="Header name"
    />
  </Field>
</template>

examples.name: Server
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Combobox from '@aziontech/webkit/combobox'
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'

  const regions = [
    { value: 'sa-east', label: 'South America (São Paulo)' },
    { value: 'us-east', label: 'US East (Virginia)' },
    { value: 'us-west', label: 'US West (Oregon)' },
    { value: 'eu-west', label: 'Europe (Frankfurt)' },
    { value: 'ap-south', label: 'Asia Pacific (Singapore)' }
  ]

  const region = ref('')
  const options = ref(regions)
  const loading = ref(false)
  let timer

  const search = (text) => {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    loading.value = true
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const needle = text.trim().toLowerCase()
      options.value = regions.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
      loading.value = false
    }, 400)
  }

  onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer))
</script>

<template>
  <Field class="max-w-(--container-xs)">
    <Field.Label>Region</Field.Label>
    <Combobox
      v-model="region"
      :options="options"
      :filter="false"
      :allow-custom="false"
      :loading="loading"
      placeholder="Search regions"
      @search="search"
    />
    <Field.Description>Only listed regions are accepted.</Field.Description>
  </Field>
</template>
